verdict.rationale: Community evidence says Granola has a free tier limited to a number of notes. The docs name Business and Enterprise plans and give scattered feature gates: API keys are restricted to Business/Enterprise, and HIPAA compliance is Enterprise-only via sales. No published prices or tier-by-tier comparison appear anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: documented per-tier pricing, a complete first-party breakdown of what each paid tier adds, first-party documentation of the free tier and its limits, and confirmation that self-serve upgrade needs no sales contact.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Granola is only free for a limited number of notes.
Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys.
Any workspace member on a **Business** or **Enterprise** plan can create API keys.
